answer: To achieve Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy, nodes implement Proof-of-Staked-Computation, requiring agents to deposit collateral and solve dynamic cryptographic challenges. During its operational voyage, each agent must route its data through a continuous river of state updates while generating a verified sonnet of zero-knowledge proofs. For an attacker, creating fake identities demands exponential capital lockup and computational costs, rendering large-scale identity spoofing financially unviable.
